grounding_quotes.text: Removes a custom field key from the allowlist for a specific entity type, preventing future use of that key across all instances of the entity. Existing values for this key on entity instances will no longer be accessible once the key is removed.
grounding_quotes.supports: The operation has durable destructive semantics across every instance of an entity type and makes pre-existing values inaccessible, which is material behavior rather than navigation-only metadata.

grounding_quotes.text:
/v1/customFields/removeKey:
    post:
      tags:
        - Custom fields
      summary: Delete a custom field key
grounding_quotes.supports: The page identifies a concrete POST operation and endpoint for deleting a custom-field key.

grounding_quotes.text:
requestBody:
        description: Remove a key from the allow list for an entity
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - entity
                - key
              properties:
                entity:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/ManagedEntity'
                key:
                  type: string
grounding_quotes.supports: The request contract requires both an entity and key, with the entity constrained by the ManagedEntity schema.

grounding_quotes.text:
example:
              entity: customer
              key: x_account_id
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Success

reason: A source summary is required because this endpoint page records consequential deletion behavior that cannot be inferred from documentation navigation: removing an allowlisted key prevents its future use across all instances of the selected entity type and makes existing values inaccessible.
